sources.snippet: Bonsai 2 27B is a ternary (1.58-bit) compression of Alibaba's open-weight Qwen3.8 27B: instead of storing each weight in 16 bits, PrismML's "ternary" scheme restricts weights to three values (+1, 0, -1), shrinking the 27.8B-parameter multimodal model to just 5.9 GB — a 9-10x memory reduction versus full precision — so it can run on a PC and ...

sources.title: PrismML — Concentrating intelligence
sources.snippet: Bonsai 2 Family Our Ternary Bonsai 2 model family spans 2B to 27B parameters, with memory footprints ranging from 0.43GB to 5.9GB. Bonsai 2 brings powerful multimodal and agentic capabilities to local AI applications across personal computers, smartphones, and wearables.
